This is my favorite game of all time. The story and character writing is the best I have ever experienced in any game, and it rivals some of my favorite stories in fiction period. The graphics, gameplay, and music is also some of the best, if not my absolute favorite, in gaming too. I was turned off to playing it for the first few months it came out because I saw it was turned based combat, and that just didn’t sound appealing to me, but I’m so glad I finally gave it a try. The amount of fun I had playing it and the emotions this game made me feel is unlike any other I have ever experienced. The mystery is also amazing and you will never guess where it’s going to go. This game is almost a perfect 10/10 for me, genuinely one of the best experiences I’ve ever had consuming any piece of media in my entire life.

This is a solid game but with some serious caveats. 

The VA, production value, and story are all excellent. I also really enjoyed completing the history and archaeology-themed puzzles!

Where this game falters is in its combat systems. The stealth and combat systems are really annoying and also finnicky. The platforming isn't particularly fun either and everything is clearly marked with white paint. 

While I do recommend this game, it's more for the atmosphere, story, and voice acting, not for the gameplay (besides the puzzles).

Alien Isolation perfectly captures the experience of dread and hopelessness you feel while watching an Alien movie. I don't think I've played another game that even come close to making you as immersed as this game does. I've played this game a few times now and it gets more and more fun with every playthrough. Every playthrough feels unique due to the different tools you have at your disposal depending on what resources you come across. If you love Alien, chances are you'll probably like the game. Not sure if it's just me but my game crashes sometimes on death, beyond that a great experience. Very excited for the sequel!
